note: S05. Timers in ticks (10/second). Evac hold is 30s = 300 ticks (design doc). startingBank seeds a NEW identity's ledger bank and is what a season rotation resets the bank to (playtest 5: a fresh player could afford no action at all).
note_landing: Playtest 13, Q50: how far hqLandingFor may travel from the requested drop cell to find a free safehouse. DELIBERATELY UNBOUNDED (9999) = the behaviour that has always shipped, held here pending the owner's ruling. Measured across 5 seeds, n=184 drops: unbounded lands 62% of drops in a district the player did not choose (median travel 30 cells on a 64 map, max 76); radius 14 cuts that to 8% but pitches the tent instead of claiming a safehouse 71% of the time, which guts the playtest-4 HQ-in-a-building ruling. There is no radius that gives both - safehouses are too sparse - so the real fix is probably citygen, and that is a balance decision. The lever stays so the ruling is a one-number edit.
